about: EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER until club staff confirm the real values (see CLAUDE.md). maxDaysBack: how many days back an incident can be dated (a write-up a few days late is normal; this stops a wrong year). maxPeople and maxBoats: the most people and boats one report can name. The rest are the longest text, in characters, each box takes: whatHappenedMax, locationMax, conditionsMax (water and weather), firstAidMax, emergencyMax and personNameMax are on the form the person on the scene fills in; causeMax, changeMax (what will change), followUpByMax, noteMax and closingNoteMax are staff's.
